badges.name: Sky Launch
badges.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished collectible achievement badge for a Grade 5 English review game, square 1024x1024 image. Input references are STYLE AND CHARACTER references, not edit targets. Match their polished hand-painted children's storybook illustration: soft visible fur, warm luminous painterly shading, expressive chibi faces, jewel-colored enamel scene, dimensional metallic substantial gold circular rim with a small top star and bottom star/laurel details. Mascots exactly: cream tabby cat with teal scarf and orange fox with white muzzle and navy neckerchief, both equally prominent, joyful competent adventurers. Large simple composition legible at 96px. Circle centered and fully in frame with about 4% warm ivory outside padding; all ears, props and decoration inside circle. No text, letters, numbers, labels, watermark, extra animals or duplicate characters. Render the scene, not an icon pasted above static mascot heads.
Badge: Sky Launch. Scene: the cat and fox wave joyfully from the open gondola of a beautiful silver-and-gold storybook airship rising into a bright azure sky, fluffy clouds, a distant emerald landscape, flowing teal and navy scarves, a few warm star sparkles. The airship balloon and both large happy faces are readable. Make this the first badge of a cohesive ten-badge collection.
